code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper}, utilities/smsutility/SmsUtil, resources/{cron-schedules-prod,application-prod,application,application-dev,application-uat}.properties. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant to this story
note: Status in stories.json: Requirement given - Gen flow, 1 point. The SMS flow for individual offenders after the 2nd letter (stage DN2): candidates with last stage DN2, notices of the same offender combined per stage and due date, template chosen from the name DN2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL (or _COMBINED), then sent in batches through APIM (SmsUtil). Blockers in repo config: (1) cron.notification.enabled=false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236), manual trigger only; (2) sms.enable=false in prod and sms.allowedSources is not set in prod (application-prod.properties:87), so SmsUtil refuses to send; (3) the DataHive number refresh is off (cron.enareminder.datahive=false). The SMS template text (refers to the 2nd letter, notice list) is in ocms_template_store (DB): cannot verify from repo. The word DOS appears nowhere in the code; DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. The demo remark ('Ask Rafif if this function is ready') cannot be confirmed from the repo. Every step is rated Sebagian on the convention that a step whose execution is switched off in the prod properties cannot be Sesuai; real server values: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially: selection, combining and filter logic exist, but the eNotification job, SMS sending and the DataHive refresh are off in the prod properties. Ask for confirmation of cron activation and the template text in the DB before a full claim

steps.step: OCMS gets the latest mobile number of the individual offender from the data source (DOS)
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo and then refreshContactInfo per notice (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-188). When enabled, individuals are looked up in Singpass DataHive (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2710-2730) and the new number is written through updateOcmsContactInfo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2800-2806). But the preload and refreshContactInfo return at once and use the stored number unless cron.enareminder.datahive is 'true' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2325-2333, 2461-2476), and that property is false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48). So the latest-number check does not run in prod; the job uses the number already in owner_driver. The word 'DOS' appears nowhere in the code; DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Vault (demo remark): cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS identifies the unique individual offenders and combines their outstanding notices in one SMS
steps.detail: combineNotices groups notices by recipient key (getRecipientKey: 'I_' + id_no for individuals, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2230-2248) + stage + due date, then joins the notice numbers and sums amount_payable (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2151-2227; called at NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:191); the list reaches the template through combinedNotices and noticeCount (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:413-430). Partial because grouping is per offender + stage + due date: an offender with notices on different due dates still gets more than one SMS, and the key is id_no, not the mobile number. It runs in the eNotification job that is off in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236).

steps.step: Offenders who opted out, hold a passport, have no valid mobile number or are companies get no SMS
steps.detail: The reminder query drops id_no values in ocms_enotification_exclusion_list (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1131-1135); the job skips excluded records or id_type P/PASSPORT (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:226-241), validateContactInfo rejects individuals without phoneNo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2259-2290), failed records are skipped with a log line and companies (id_type B) stay out of the SMS batch (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:254-275). The logic matches the story, but it runs in the eNotification job that is off in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236), hence Sebagian. Note: loadAllExcludedIds is fail-open (empty set when the read fails, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1207-1213). The content of the exclusion list: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The SMS contains the outstanding notices and refers to the 2nd letter reminder/notification
steps.detail: For reminders the template stage comes from last_processing_stage (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:174-179), so a notice that just passed DN2 uses template DN2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL (or DN2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL_COMBINED for more than one notice): the name is built by determineTemplateName from stage, channel and recipient type (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:283-301, 459-476); the data carries noticeNo, combinedNotices, noticeCount, amountPayable, paymentDueDate (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:413-430). If the template is missing in the DB the SMS is skipped with an error log (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:303-310). Partial because the template text lives in ocms_template_store (DB), so whether it refers to the 2nd letter and lists the notices: cannot verify from repo. Note: for companies the DN1/DN2/DR3 email is skipped with 'no template available' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:311-317); this story covers individual SMS only.

steps.step: The SMS is sent to the individual offender in a batch job
steps.detail: The job calls sendBatchSms (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:289-292), which splits records into batches and calls smsUtil.sendBatchSmsSimple with source ENOTIFICATION through APIM (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1527-1530, 1611-1612). Partial for three reasons: (1) cron.notification.enabled=false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236), manual trigger only; (2) sms.enable=false in prod (application-prod.properties:87) and SmsUtil refuses to send unless the source is in sms.allowedSources (SmsUtil.java:401-408), while sms.allowedSources=ENOTIFICATION is set only in dev/uat (application-dev.properties:85, application-uat.properties:82) and not in prod; notification.sms.enabled=true in application.properties:176 is only a job-level flag. Real server values and the APIM/SMS gateway: cannot verify from repo.
